:::{#sol-rank-dim-practice}

In $\matr{A}$, the second column is $(2, 4, 6) = 2\,(1, 2, 3)$,
so by @thm-column-space-span

$$
\mathcal{C}(\matr{A}) = \operatorname{span}\cb{(1, 2, 3), (2, 4, 6)} = \operatorname{span}\cb{(1, 2, 3)}.
$$

The single nonzero vector $(1, 2, 3)$ is a [basis](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-basis) of that [span](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-span),
so $\dim\paren{\mathcal{C}(\matr{A})} = 1$,
and by @thm-rank-dim, $\rankf{\matr{A}} = 1$.

:::
